test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A and B can do a work in 18 days, B and C can do the same work in 15 days, while A and C can do the work in 12 days. The time taken by them to complete the work by working together is:
solution:
Given

A and B can do a piece of work in 18 days

B and C can do the same work in 15 days

A and C can do the same work in 12 days

Formula:

Total work = Efficiency × time

Calculation:

Total work = LCM of (18, 15 and 12) = 180 unit

Efficiency of A and B = 10 units

Efficiency of B and C = 12 units

Efficiency of C and A = 15 units

Efficiency of A, B and C = (10 + 12 + 15)/2 = 37/2 units

Time taken together = 180/(37/2) = 360/37 = 9(27)/(37) days

**The answer is 9(27)/(37) days.**
